body: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production eight-direction car BODY-ONLY sprite sheet for the game Last on Grid, original logo-free 2994 salvage style. Create an ORIGINAL ultra-short three-door city hatchback named Quince, loosely inspired by the proportions of a 2014 Japanese iQ but NOT a literal replica. Extremely short 3m-long tall rounded cabin, single long side door per side, tiny rear quarter window, near-vertical hatch, cropped stubby nose. Distinctive muted plum body, cream roof patch and charcoal bumpers; small separate circular headlamps in rectangular recesses, wide narrow low grille, original thin horizontal rear lamps. Hand-painted detailed grounded semi-realistic weathered game sprites, scratches/oxidation but structurally intact. No manufacturer badges, logos, readable text, people or scene. Output wide transparent sheet 3:1 aspect, EXACTLY eight equal cells in four columns by two rows, consistent vehicle scale and diffuse lighting. Top row left-to-right: straight front; front three-quarter nose pointing LEFT; full side nose LEFT; rear three-quarter nose RIGHT. Bottom row: straight rear; rear three-quarter nose LEFT; full side nose RIGHT; front three-quarter nose RIGHT. Each car centered completely inside its cell, generous transparent margins and separation; flat horizon/eye-height game camera, not overhead. CRITICAL body shell only: no wheels, tires, rims, hubs or suspension. All wheel wells are genuine alpha-transparent semicircular cutouts open to bottom, never dark opaque backing; game draws rotating wheels behind body. Preserve solid body panels above arches. Front/rear views have no black blocks where wheels go. Transparent background and transparent space below chassis. No shadows on ground, no checkerboard painted into image.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production cockpit dashboard overlay for Last on Grid. Original logo-free Quince 2014, ultra-short Japanese urban hatchback, salvage survivor in year2994. Right-hand-drive: instrument binnacle on RIGHT centered near75percent image width. Hand-painted detailed grounded semi-realistic style, worn charcoal dashboard and faded plum lower fascia, cream repair patch, asymmetrical compact center console with rounded trapezoid vents and plain dark radio rectangle. Horizontal wide2.5:1 image. All dashboard occupies ONLY bottom35percent, top65percent genuinely alpha-transparent windshield area so live game world shows through. View straight ahead from driver, no visible steeringwheel at all (shared wheel inserted by game), no hands/people. Binnacle on RIGHT: one broad empty near-black recessed flat rectangular blank display area with sufficient room for runtime speed/RPM/gear; absolutely no printed gauges, digits, needles, text, logos, UI or lights inside. Binnacle x63–86percent width,y72–88percent height. Left passenger dash softly curved; bottomsolid continuous toimageedge; keep pillars minimal farleft/farright. No scenic windshield, hood, seats, mirrors, checkerboard, watermark. Diffuse neutral light, scuffed material and worn seams, visually clear outline. Transparent background preserved.
